parameters.query: SELECT id::text AS id, contenido FROM knowledge_base WHERE id IN (20, 21, 24, 25, 36, 39, 40, 45, 41, 29, 30, 37, 42, 44, 3, 22, 23, 1, 26, 28, 43, 32, 33) UNION ALL (SELECT 'asiri:' || id::text AS id, left(contenido, 600) AS contenido FROM knowledge_base WHERE metadata->>'asiri' = 'true' AND coalesce(metadata->>'archivado', '') <> 'true' AND id NOT IN (20, 21, 24, 25, 36, 39, 40, 45, 41, 29, 30, 37, 42, 44, 3, 22, 23, 1, 26, 28, 43, 32, 33) ORDER BY id LIMIT 12) UNION ALL SELECT 'dir:' || clave AS id, valor AS contenido FROM agente_directrices WHERE clave IN ('notas_para_asiri', 'menu_bienvenida') OR left(clave, 4) = 'msg_' ORDER BY 1
